name: track_activities
description: Enables collection of per-session information about the currently executing command and its start time.
symptoms: Inability to monitor active queries in real time
Missing data in pg_stat_activity for troubleshooting
Limited visibility into long-running or stuck sessions
tuning_tips: Keep enabled unless auditing or monitoring is strictly prohibited; disabling saves minimal overhead but sacrifices critical observability. Only superusers can change it.
